env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/hello$GOEXE .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.tz' $WORK/hello$GOEXE
stdout 'TZCNT'
cd base
logos build -o $WORK/hello-base$GOEXE .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.tz' $WORK/hello-base$GOEXE
! stdout 'TZCNT'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/targetcpuisa

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math/bits"
)

//go:noinline
func tz(x uint64) uint64 {
	return uint64(bits.TrailingZeros64(x))
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(tz(8))
}

-- m/base/go.mod --
module example.com/targetcpuisa/base

go 1.27

-- m/base/logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "baseline"

-- m/base/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math/bits"
)

//go:noinline
func tz(x uint64) uint64 {
	return uint64(bits.TrailingZeros64(x))
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(tz(8))
}
